svg.title: System architecture: services flows (Built)
svg.desc: Pages, services and stores grouped by domain stage, with every services flow drawn as an arrow carrying its flow number (F67 to F77 in the flow table). 12 nodes, 11 flows.

g.title: Flow 67 (F67): ref-mb Postgres → ref_mb MusicBrainz mirror – MusicBrainz reference lookups [services, Built]
